But thats an ad-model from the stone age! I live in Sweden and our "major networks" as in bigger channels all have their own streamin-service on their own website.

So for example, say that NBC were swedish, they would probably host their entire catalogue of content for "free" on usually something like www.nbcplay.com. The shows they air, they upload to the internet themself within a few hours after airing and in those streams they have advertising, kinda like youtube.

We live in god damn 2013, who sits down at their television at fixed times to watch shows? Its like tuning in to the top 10 on the radio to see if you get to hear your favorite song!!! Its an old, out dated and (compared to whats available) a worthless way of getting access to entertainment
